lightsheetZarrLevel.name: label
lightsheetZarrLevel.documentation: Human-readable name for this level. Empty allowed.

lightsheetZarrLevel.name: level
lightsheetZarrLevel.documentation: 0-based level index within the parent pyramid. 0 is the finest.

lightsheetZarrLevel.name: reduction
lightsheetZarrLevel.documentation: Reduction of this level relative to level 0 ('mean', 'max', ...).

lightsheetZarrLevel.name: shape
lightsheetZarrLevel.documentation: Per-axis size of this level's array, in axes_order.

lightsheetZarrLevel.name: chunk_grid
lightsheetZarrLevel.documentation: Per-axis count of chunks along each axis = ceil(shape ./ chunks).

lightsheetZarrLevel.name: chunk_index_origin
lightsheetZarrLevel.documentation: First # in the chunk.bin_# series. Always 1 by convention.

lightsheetZarrLevel.name: byte_order
lightsheetZarrLevel.documentation: Byte order of the on-disk chunk bytes.

lightsheetZarrLevel.name: codec_params
lightsheetZarrLevel.documentation: JSON-encoded string of the codec parameters.

lightsheetZarrLevel.name: voxel_size
lightsheetZarrLevel.documentation: Per-axis voxel size at this level.
